column1: # SARS-CoV-2 Spike (S) functional domains and sites, in the standard Wuhan-Hu-1
# S numbering (= the app's S PositionBase; verified: furin RRAR at 682-685, S2'
# S686, fusion peptide from 816, RBD/RBM anchors match). Two groups:
#   Domains         - NTD and RBD, the two S1 domains that carry most antigenic
#                     variation (RBD = ACE2 receptor-binding domain; NTD carries
#   Functional sites- ACE2 contact residues (receptor-binding motif; Lan et al.
#                     2020, PDB 6M0J), the S1/S2 furin cleavage site, and the
# 6VXX is the Wuhan closed prefusion trimer; its 475-486 RBM loop and the
# 682-685 furin loop are disordered, so a few of those residues are unmodeled.
